summary: Marvel's Midnight Suns entries added from the live guide-pack catalogue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Marvel's Midnight Suns
entries.definitive_edition: Marvel's Midnight Suns Legendary Edition on Windows PC (base game + Deadpool, Venom, Morbius and Storm packs)

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulation branch.

primary.version: Marvel's Midnight Suns Legendary Edition (Steam / Epic Games Store)
primary.why: Legendary Edition carries the Season Pass, i.e. all four post-launch character packs — Deadpool, Venom, Morbius and Storm (Blood Storm) — each adding story missions, an Abbey upgrade and skins, so it is the complete content route. PC is also the fidelity route: the current-gen console versions match its content but cap settings, and the last-gen PS4 / Xbox One versions are digital-only cutdowns.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Legendary Edition on Windows PC. Record storefront/build, which of the four DLC character packs are installed, difficulty, roster and card-deck state, and Abbey upgrade progress.

all_releases.fidelity: Highest settings/resolution ceiling; Legendary Edition includes all four post-launch character packs.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity and the complete content set.
skip: same content as PC but console-capped settings.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No conflict: the PC Legendary Edition is both the most complete and the highest fidelity route. The cancelled Switch version means there is no portable branch.

entries.remaster_caveats: Buying the base game alone omits all four character packs; confirm the Legendary Edition or Season Pass before starting a completion run.
